meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Telegram 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Telegram 频道消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Telegram channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Telegram channel messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会安装并注册 Telegram 适配器,引导你在 Telegram 的 BotFather 创建机器人、提供 token,再用配对码验证你的聊天,之后就能通过 Telegram 和 Claude 对话。
howto.when: 当你要求把 Telegram 机器人或频道接入 NanoClaw 或 Claude 时触发,比如说到“添加 Telegram”“接入 Telegram bot”。

say.text: 帮我添加 Telegram 机器人集成
say.note: Claude 会开始安装适配器并引导配置。

say.text: 把 Telegram 频道接进来,我想在 Telegram 里跟你说话
say.note: 之后会进入 BotFather 创建机器人和配对流程。

say.text: 配置 Telegram bot,用配对码绑定我的聊天
say.note: Claude 会启动配对步骤,生成代码让你发送给机器人。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude installs and registers the Telegram adapter, guides you to create a bot via BotFather and provide the token, then verifies your chat with a pairing code, enabling messaging through Telegram.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Telegram bot or channel to NanoClaw or Claude, e.g. saying 'add Telegram' or 'integrate Telegram bot'.

say_en.text: Help me add Telegram bot integration
say_en.note: Claude will install the adapter and start setup.

say_en.text: Connect Telegram so I can chat with you there
say_en.note: You'll create a bot and complete pairing.

say_en.text: Set up Telegram bot with pairing code
say_en.note: Claude starts pairing and gives you a code.
